title: Canonical etale pullback of a normalization arrow
statement: Let Y be a scheme, q:R→S a commutative ring homomorphism, C a derived R-module sheaf and D a derived S-module sheaf on Y_et [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. For d:C→Res_q(D) and an etale Y-object U, define its localized normalization arrow by applying the exact etale inverse image to d and then the canonical derived coefficient mate. Its endpoints are C|U and Res_q(D|U); use the source-site exact restriction of [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf]. No universal property or invertibility is assumed.
